'''Ethan Temianka''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Eagle Rock tournament]] on 9 June 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down (Battle Order)]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB (no starting interrupt)]], according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2446">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01d2446/ eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 12 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01d2446/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
